WHAT IS KALSHI?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

 - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

 - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.




ROLE ROADMAP

As part of the Corp Dev / BD team at Kalshi, you'll help identify and execute the strategic opportunities that can accelerate the company's growth. You'll work directly with leadership to evaluate where Kalshi should build, buy, partner, or expand - from acquisitions and strategic investments to partnerships, new markets, and distribution opportunities. You'll be responsible for finding the right opportunities, developing the business case, and driving them from initial conversation through execution.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Identify and evaluate M&A, strategic investment, partnership, and other business development opportunities

 - Build relationships with founders, financial institutions, fintech companies, technology platforms, investors, and other strategic partners

 - Develop business cases, financial models, and strategic analyses to evaluate potential transactions and partnerships

 - Lead opportunities from initial sourcing and outreach through diligence, negotiation, execution, and launch

 - Partner directly with the executive team to evaluate new markets, products, geographies, and strategic initiatives

 - Develop clear build, buy, or partner recommendations based on financial, strategic, and operational considerations

 - Coordinate cross-functional diligence and execution across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Operations

 - Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, strategic partnerships, investments, and acquisitions

 - Build and maintain a pipeline of companies, partners, and opportunities that could be strategically valuable to Kalshi

 - Track market developments, competitors, and emerging trends across trading, fintech, payments, financial infrastructure, and adjacent markets

 - Support post-transaction integration and help ensure strategic partnerships and acquisitions deliver against their objectives




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years of experience in corporate development, business development, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, strategy, or a related field

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience evaluating complex strategic or transaction opportunities

 - Experience sourcing, negotiating, or executing M&A, investments, partnerships, or other strategic transactions

 - Excellent judgment - able to quickly understand a business or opportunity and identify the factors that matter most

 - Strong commercial instincts and comfort negotiating with sophisticated counterparties

 - Experience working directly with senior leadership and communicating complex analysis in a clear, concise way

 - Ability to build relationships with founders, executives, investors, and strategic partners

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and a lot of ambiguity

 - High level of ownership and the ability to drive complex, cross-functional projects from idea

About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.


Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.


Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.




THIS ROLE:

The Senior Analytics Engineer will own the analytics data products that our internal teams rely on to make decisions. You will turn prototypes and one-off analyses into trusted, production-grade models and metrics. That means reusable models, business-facing metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and the guidance our Lightdash AI agents need to answer questions correctly.

This role reports directly to the Director of Data and works closely with the rest of the data team and with internal partners such as GTM and Finance. It is a hands-on role that combines modeling judgment with stakeholder discovery.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own analytics data products across internal business functions

 - Design and maintain reusable intermediate models, business-facing gold models, metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and Lightdash agent guidance

 - Turn ideas into production data products by working with stakeholders to define requirements, validating the results, and publishing them

 - Reconcile concepts that differ across source systems, and publish mappings, unmatched records, assumptions, and quality checks so conflicts stay visible

 - Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests, Lightdash metadata, access rules, content validation, and AI agent instructions

 - Diagnose incorrect or stale results across the data layers, and partner with data engineering when the cause sits below the serving layer

 - Review modeling changes, pair with teammates, and help maintain shared standards
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:




CORE QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of analytics engineering or equivalent experience, including contribution to a production dbt project with tests, CI, incremental models, and documentation

 - Strong dimensional modeling judgment: you can design conformed entities and facts at the correct grain, and make clear decisions when source systems use conflicting definitions

 - Experience delivering a metrics or semantic layer used by both people and tools, with safe access controls for sensitive data

 - Familiarity with and regular use of AI coding agents. You verify their output and know when they are not the right tool

 - Strong SQL skills and enough Python experience to understand existing pipelines and build transformation tasks

 - Clear technical writing. You treat model documentation and metric definitions as part of the data product
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with Lightdash, or another semantic layer managed as code

 - AWS knowledge and familiarity with tools like Athe

Associate Actuary – Casualty Specialty Markets 
 At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Associate Actuary – Casualty Specialty Markets to take on key responsibilities within a world-class actuarial function.
 Make your mark in Actuarial 
 Our Actuaries are on the front lines, quantifying risk, pricing insurance and reserving losses for AIG’s major insurance operating companies, globally. We collaborate with Finance, Claims, Operations, Marketing and Risk Management, among other functions. As an AIG actuary, you will be challenged and encouraged to reach your greatest potential to help improve how we predict, manage and mitigate risk.
 How you will create an impact 
We are seeking an actuary with industry expertise to provide pricing, analytics, and technical support to the Energy, Trucking and Environmental Portfolios, with a focus on Commercial Auto Liability under the supervision of Casualty Specialty Market lead pricing actuary.  This position involves profitability analysis / deep dive, rater development and maintenance, large accounts pricing review, monthly business KPI reporting, assisting with annual budget and setting portfolio strategy.  Additional duties include supporting quarterly earnings-related reporting, business AvE, diagnostics and large loss reporting.   They will partner with other actuaries in implementing best practices, analytical techniques and assessing the impact of loss trends and claims emergence.   Also, they will be responsible for one direct report.
- Work closely with underwriting to develop pricing, underwriting strategies, identify pockets of profitable growth opportunities and future underwriting actions.
- Support the business review process and portfolio deep dives, which include reviewing underwriting actions impacting loss ratios to access impact on current and future performance.
- Ensure accuracy of quoting and rating systems by working with Underwriters.
- Ensure execution of rate level indications, portfolio profitability exercise and rate reviews within planned time frame
- Collaborate with data team to drive process improvement and achieve actuarial transformation goals
- Development and production of premium adequacy reports and budget loss ratio estimates for various segments.
- Perform peer review for actuarial work products.
- Communicate with and advise senior management, underwriters, comptrollers, claims department. 
- Work effectively as part of a team and train junior staff to achieve AIG’s financial, strategic and operational objectives
 What we are lookingh for 
- At least an Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS)
- At least 5 years of commercial lines actuarial experience, preferably with significant commercial auto pricing experience.
- Exceptional communication skills, including ability to develop and present clear and concise analysis and recommendations to senior management.
- Willing and able to continuously learn and adapt in a dynamic and fast changing environment. 
- Timeliness and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Snowflake, Python, R, or other programming languages preferred
 The base salary range for this position is $120,00-$150,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits Overview

 Make your mark in Actuarial 
 Our Actuaries are on the front lines, quantifying risk, pricing insurance and reserving losses for AIG’s major insurance operating companies, globally. We collaborate with Finance, Claims, Operations, Marketing and Risk Management, among other functions. As an AIG actuary, you will be challenged and encouraged to reach your greatest potential to help improve how we predict, manage and mitigate risk.
 How you will create an impact 
 We are seeking a dynamic Senior Actuarial Analyst to assist with pricing the US Programs business.  The Senior Actuarial Analyst will help elevate the technical capabilities of the underwriting team through dynamic work projects such as new program due diligence & onboarding, rate filings, rate studies, price monitoring, trend analyses, and building out portfolio management tools.  The individual will be a trusted business partner, working with groups such as underwriting and product development to understand account decision making and pricing practices to support Programs in ensuring profitable growth. - Complete profitability studies on assigned programs and present analysis in front of business partners at varying levels of the organization

- Engage with MGA underwriters and actuaries

- Work with the underwriters and rate filings unit to manage program specific and state rate filings 
- Produce and distribute relevant recurring reports as required  
- Support development and maintenance of pricing tools such as pricing models, raters, and other analytical tools. 
 What we’re looking for 
- 3+ CAS exams
- Programming proficiency required (e.g. SQL, Python, VBA, R, etc)

The Central Reserving team is seeking a highly analytical and innovative professional to help advance our reserving capabilities through the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics. This role will be responsible for developing tools and models that identify and quantify key drivers of claims outcomes, uncover insights into loss development behavior, and enhance reserving accuracy across multiple lines of business.
 In addition, this role will support the analysis, determination, and reporting of reserves for Extra-Contractual Obligations (ECO) and Corporate-Level Unallocated Loss Expense (ULE).
 The successful candidate will partner with reserving actuaries, claims professionals, data scientists, and business leaders to transform complex datasets into actionable insights, modern analytical tools, and next-generation reserving methodologies.
 This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of actuarial reserving by combining traditional actuarial expertise with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics capabilities.
 Key Responsibilities: 
- Support the quarterly process of determining the appropriate amount of IBNR to be booked across assigned reserving segments, including Extra-Contractual Obligations (ECO) and Corporate-Level Unallocated Loss Expense (ULE). 
- Analyze information to determine, document, and communicate the adequacy of loss and loss expense reserves. 
- Develop and apply advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-based tools to identify and quantify key drivers of claims outcomes, improve reserve estimates, and generate business insights into loss development behavior. 
- Research, develop, and enhance reserving methodologies and models to improve reserve accuracy and support actuarial transformation initiatives. 
- Analyze and monitor loss development trends, claims emergence patterns, and relevant industry, regulatory, and operational changes, and effectively communicate findings to management. 
- Partner with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) to analyze reserve risk for use in capital modeling purposes. 
- Assist with quarterly financial and regulatory reporting (quarter close) and provide data and exhibits for annual statement reporting, including ECO and ULE reporting requirements. 
- Collaborate with Claims, Finance, Pricing, Data Science, and Technology teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, and achieve reserving modernization objectives. 
- Work effectively both independently and as part of a team to achieve the organization's financial, strategic, and operational objectives. 
 Qualifications: 
- BS in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related area
- ACAS or FCAS
- 4 or more years of experience in reserving and/or pricing
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Work well both independently and as part of a team
- Proficiency in Excel, SQL, SAS, Python, R, or other programming languages preferred
- Strong business and collaboration skills and responsive to service needs and operational demands
- Effective time management skill

 Sanofi is committed to maximizing the full potential of Dupixent across the respiratory space, building a robust and differentiated evidence base that demonstrates its transformative value to patients, payers, and health systems. Through a focused and rapidly expanding body of clinical and real-world evidence, Sanofi aims to address critical gaps in care and deliver meaningful, potentially life-changing treatment options for the millions of patients living with Type 2 inflammatory respiratory conditions who continue to face significant unmet need.

We operate as One Team , partnering without boundaries while pursuing a Bold Purpose through ambitious, measurable goals.  The Senior Manager, Stewardship Operations, Quality & Evidence is responsible for the continuous data-quality monitoring capability for enterprise planning data, turning ratified standards and business rules into active checks, routed flags, and decision-ready evidence. This role owns the monitoring, escalation-routing, and reporting cadence that keeps data quality issues visible before they reach a finished report, and compiles the evidence base the Data Stewardship Council and senior leadership use to review conformance and prioritize future stewardship work. Reporting to the Director, Data Stewardship, this position operationalizes the monitoring and evidence pillar of the enterprise stewardship operating model, working in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Stewardship & Standards, whose ratified definitions and RACI assignments this role monitors against.  
 When & where: 
- Location: TarryTown NY, or Warren NJ
- Travel percentage: 10%
 Discover your role: 
- Operate and continuously improve enterprise data-quality monitoring in Planisware (leveraging the Data Quality Audit capability), configuring checks to reflect currently ratified definitions, business rules, and RACI assignments.  
- Monitor planning data continuously against core data-quality dimensions – completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, and timeliness – and route flagged issues directly to the accountable plan owner for resolution at the source.  
- Compile and maintain the monthly data-quality summary presented to the Data Stewardship Council, highlighting recurring issues, trends by function, and items requiring escalation.  
- Produce the quarterly data-quality trend report for senior leadership, providing the evidence base used to prioritize future stewardship and quality initiatives.

- Partner with Digital & Technology to keep monitoring tooling configured to current ratified standards, distinguishing tooling or system defects from underlying data-content issues and routing each to the correct owner.  
- Track and report adoption and conformance by role – Data Creator, Curator, Enabler, and Consumer – to identify where an agreed expectation is not being met and where follow-up is needed.  
- Support the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Stewardship & Standards, and the Director, Data Stewardship, in assembling monitoring evidence for decision records and escalation packages when a flagged finding surfaces a cross-functional disagreement requiring Council resolution.  
- Track and report on monitoring coverage (e.g., share of required or active milestone codes under active monitoring) and issue closure rates, providing input to the broader stewardship roadmap and operating-model maturity.  
- Collaborate with system Business Process Owner (e.g., Planisware, Planview) and Program, Portfolio Management, and Program Management leads to ensure monitoring reflects current planning-system configuration and usage.  
 This role requires: 
- Working knowledge of drug development, clinical/program planning, and portfolio management terminology and processes.  
- Demonstrated experience operating or administering data-quality monitoring, audit, or observability capabilities (e.g., automated data-quality checks, exception and alert routing, conformance dashboards), ideally within a data governance or data management framework.  
- Skilled in defining and tracking data-quality metrics against recognized dimensions (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness) and translating monitoring output into clear findings.

Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry. 
 Job Description 
 Ares is seeking an accomplished Senior Human Resources Business Partner to support its Global Client Solutions (GCS) and Wealth Management Solutions (WMS) businesses. This role will serve as a senior HR advisor to GCS and WMS leadership and will play a critical role in shaping and executing the talent and organizational strategies that support the continued growth and evolution of these businesses.
 The Senior HRBP will partner closely with senior GCS and WMS leaders to build, develop, and retain high-performing teams capable of delivering against the firm's ambitious growth objectives. The role requires a strategic, commercially minded HR leader who can operate effectively at the most senior levels of the organization, understand the dynamics of global client-facing and distribution businesses, navigate complex organizational issues, and translate business priorities into effective talent strategies.
 The successful candidate will bring deep expertise across talent management, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, workforce planning, succession planning, performance management, and employee relations. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leadership while helping the businesses scale effectively, develop leadership capability, strengthen talent pipelines, and evolve their organizational models to support continued growth.
 Ares is a fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving organization. Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic advisory and hands-on execution, exercise sound judgment in complex situations, and build strong relationships across businesses, functions, geographies, and levels of the organization.
 Reporting relationships
 Reports to: Head of Talent 
 Primary functions & responsibilities
 ·         Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior GCS and WMS leaders, developing a deep understanding of business strategy, growth objectives, organizational priorities, and talent needs to deliver commercially relevant HR strategies and solutions.
 ·         Partner closely with business leadership to develop and execute talent and organizational strategies that enable growth and ensure the organization has the right talent, structure, and capabilities to deliver against evolving business priorities.
 ·         Advise leadership on organizational design and effectiveness, including operating models, spans and layers, role clarity, team structures, leadership accountabilities, and organizational capabilities required to support continued scale and growth.
 ·         Lead strategic workforce and headcount planning, partnering with leadership to anticipate future talent and capability requirements and align investment in talent with business priorities.
 ·         Drive succession planning and talent reviews across GCS and WMS, identifying critical roles and talent and developing thoughtful succession and development strategies.
 ·         Proactively identify organizational, talent, and workforce trends across the businesses and translate these into actionable insights and recommendations to strengthen organizational effectiveness, talent outcomes, and the employee experience.

 Job Description 
 Ares Insurance Solutions (AIS) is seeking an Analyst to support the Asset Analytics and Data Operations function responsible for investment portfolios backing life and annuity insurance liabilities. This role will focus on maintaining the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data used across investment management, actuarial, finance, and forecasting processes.
 The Analyst will play a key role in identifying, investigating, and resolving data anomalies, reconciliation exceptions, and data discrepancies across multiple investment systems and data sources, helping ensure the integrity and reliability of investment data used across the organization. Working closely with Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, the Analyst will support critical data governance and operational processes. The individual will also assist with the preparation and validation of asset-related inputs for FP&A and projection models and may support the execution of forecasting tools and processes.
 This role is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional interested in investment operations, insurance asset management, data governance, and cross-functional problem-solving.
 Responsibilities: 
 Asset Data Management and Reconciliation 
- Monitor the quality, accuracy, and completeness of investment data across various asset classes, including public fixed income, structured products, private credit, mortgages, and alternative investments.
- Perform daily, monthly, and quarter-end reconciliations across investment accounting systems, portfolio management platforms, custodians, data warehouses, and analytical applications.
- Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks involving positions, market values, book values, cash balances, accrued interest, investment income, ratings, security master attributes, and cash flows.
- Analyze data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions across multiple sources and determine root causes, whether related to source feeds, accounting treatment, data transformations, system configurations, timing differences, or operational processes.
- Partner with Investment Operations, Accounting, Technology, and external service providers to investigate and resolve data anomalies and reconciliation exceptions and validate remediation efforts.
- Maintain reconciliation inventories, exception logs, and support documentation to ensure transparency and auditability of the resolution process.
- Ensure data consistency across upstream and downstream systems supporting investment management, actuarial modeling, FP&A, regulatory reporting, and management reporting.
- Assist in establishing and enhancing data quality controls, exception monitoring, and operational workflows to proactively identify anomalies before they impact business processes.
- Support data validation efforts related to new security onboarding, portfolio transfers, acquisitions, system implementations, and data migration projects.
 Cross-Functional Coordination 
- Serve as a key liaison between Asset Analytics, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, and Technology teams.
- Communicate data anomalies, reconciliation findings, business requirements, and remediation priorities to stakeholders across functions.

workday:R6765.description:
Banking Americas 
 Mizuho’s Banking Division provides corporate and investment banking coverage, sponsor coverage, advisory and solutions and loan capital markets/syndicate to Mizuho’s client base of leading international corporations, financial institutions and public sector entities in the US and Canada. Banking supports client business activities throughout the region with an extensive range of capital markets and lending capabilities and an integrated team of coverage, advisory and product bankers responsible for client relationship management and strategic transaction development to execute banking and securities mandates and originate idea generation for potential acquisitions, divestitures and investment opportunities. 
 About the Role: 
 Investment & Corporate Analysts are directly involved in the design, origination, structuring and execution of financial advisory, global capital markets, financial risk management, structured & syndicated finance, and other global products and services for existing and prospective clients.  An Analyst is expected to understand the implications, identify key industry and product trends and provide input on pitch and deal material to enhance the ultimate deliverable.
 Analysts are assigned to a variety of projects and are given a broad range of responsibilities, some of which include:
- Conduct extensive quantitative economic, industry and company research and analysis
- Conduct and model a broad range of corporate finance alternatives and due diligence for client transactions including M&A, strategic alternatives, capital structure development, acquisition finance and syndicated loan and capital market financing
- Evaluate risk/return parameters of financing transactions
- Financial modeling, valuation, comparable & relative value analyses and market-specific analysis
- Facilitate and coordinate product group idea generation and solutions development across a broad platform of global capabilities
- Draft client pitches and marketing materials including M&A, syndicated bank financing, public/private debt & equity capital markets, and other internal documentation by coordinating internal and external resources
- Assist in financing structuring, underwriting transaction evaluation, preparation, due diligence and execution
- Assist in the development and continued cultivation of client relationships
 Qualifications :
- Bachelors degree in Finance or Economics and a minimum of 1 year corporate finance and capital markets experience with a top tier global bank
- Knowledge of corporate finance, securities, financial markets and risk & pricing analysis
- Aptitude to synthesize large amounts of information and develop innovative ideas and/or product solutions
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines
- Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to convey ideas
- Creativity and intellectual curiosity
- Ability to work independently and must be able to work effectively in a team environment
- Advanced proficiency with FactSet, CapitalIQ, Bloomberg, Microsoft Office
- Series 79 & 63
 The expected base salary ranges from $110K - $130k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.
 Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Mizuho does not sponsor applicants for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position.  This includes, but is not limited to, any sponsorship or administrative assistance or execution of any documentation related to F-1 (CPT/OPT/STEM OPT), TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1 or H-1B applicatio

SUMMARY: 
 Associates in Corporate Credit Structuring (“CCS”) work with Coverage Bankers to originate, structure, and negotiate facilities (including syndicated and bilateral loans, bridge, acquisition and structured financing across an IG, HY and Financial Sponsor client base as well as trade management solutions) for existing and prospective clients.  An Associate is expected to manage and monitor a sector credit portfolio, providing strategic direction in framing client opportunities and structuring transactions with a balanced focus on risk-return parameters, lead initiatives to drive client responsiveness and productivity. Working closely with Coverage and other product and risk management partners around the globe, Banking Americas utilizes its expertise to deliver creative ideas and tailor-made solutions to clients. 
 PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :
- Work closely with Banking Americas Originations and Product Partners to identify customer business opportunities and gather required information to complete a business screening process.
- Respond to various customer requests.
- Prepare capital allocation / profitability projection package to assess the business case and secure required internal support and approvals.
- Prepare credit applications on new transactions and renewals, outlining transaction rationale, structure, terms and conditions, exposure management plan, business strategy and relationship return analysis, and any other requested or required forms or information needed to complete a proper assessment of the transaction.
 As part of credit application process, prepare:
- Front Sheets, Collateral and Guarantee Registrations, Facility Rating Simulations
- Coordinate/Manage all compliance requirements (Conflict of Interest, Reputational Risk, KYC, etc.)
- Ensure all related internal policies and procedures are followed, including sector/industry risk limits
- Work seamlessly with Credit Risk counterparts to coordinate completion of credit assessment, assisting with any required due diligence needed to finalize the credit opinion/approvals.
- Assist in financing structuring, underwriting transaction evaluation, preparation, due diligence and execution. Review and/or prepare legal documents in conjunction with in-house or outside counsel.
- Prepare, analyze and review transaction proposals, focusing on structure, terms and conditions and profitability
- Engage with Customer, Agent Bank, Bank Participants, Legal, Compliance and Operations to ensure seamless deal execution for the Client.
- Conduct in depth review of all legal documentation, in addition to commitment letters, NDAs, and LOIs, etc. (working with the Legal Department or Outside Counsel, as required)
- Engage Portfolio Management Team to optimize portfolio via risk mitigation measures (CDS, loan sales, CRI), assess appetite/returns and to monitor the portfolio
- Make recommendations on action/plan to Credit Risk (and senior management, when necessary) as it relates to credit issues/restructuring/exposure management.
- As part of first line of defense, act as credit steward monitoring client performance trends / market movements in coordination with risk and make recommendations for action plans as it relates to client credit issues/restructuring/exposure management. Monitor market movements and news in coordination with Credit Risk – submitting Form 19, when applicable.
- Manage credit issues with the clients – including assessment of requests/changes and restructuring balancing need to support client with protection of the Bank’s balance sheet.
- Assist with regulatory related requests/meetings/presentations, as needed.
- Assist with audit related requests/meetings/presentations, as needed.
 Qualifications: 
- Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Business, Finance or Economics or strong quantitative background
- Formalized Credit Training from an accredited financial institution (minimum 3-5 years credit experience) and

workday:R7073-2.description:
Join Mizuho as a Risk Tech Analyst! 
 In this role, you will be part of the NPE (New product Enablement) team whose purpose is to support Quants and Risk models validation efforts. The ideal candidate will specifically help generate and assess the calculated data quality, which is a critical function to ensure a rapid time to market of new products.
 Support 
- Assist Quants, Risk Analytics and Market Risk teams in generating the numbers out of the Murex & Calculation engine platforms (SIMM crif files, PL Vectors for VaR, Backtesting, DRC, FRTB SA).
- Troubleshoot issues related to generated data quality, validate required static / market data /scenarios and other valuation settings.
- Rerun as needed data/files depending on various data requests from Risk Analytics/Quants users to provide end to end support on Risk framework.
 Business Solution Evolution 
- Configure Murex environments, working with FO-IT & RISK-IT, to enable requested calculations.
- Support the evolution of the automation of the data generation by giving continuous feedback to the Market Risk development team managing the local calculation platforms (Murex, Polypath, BER).
- Support the implementation of new products/models within the Murex and Polypath Calculation platforms & other in-house applications used at Mizuho.
- Support mapping configurations and data preparation required for integration with the Global Risk platform – Matsuri.
- Escalate problems proactively and ensure all stakeholders are kept aware of issues and their development.
- Develop test plans for enhancements & new products initiated by Front office, or Risk and requiring analytics documentation/validation.
- Create and maintain a knowledge base, support scripts, documentation and procedures.
- Collaborate with different IT teams to support multi-platforms’ integration and risk data generation effort.
 Qualifications: 
- At least 3+ years of experience supporting a Derivatives line of business (IRD, FXO, EQD) or a Market Risk cross Asset or cross-platform implementation, preferably using Murex 3.1.
- Working knowledge in derivatives analytics allowing to engage with Risk Managers.
- Working knowledge of Market Risk practices (stress testing, VaR, FRTB, Time Series and valuation).
- Familiarity with core calculation modules (Pricing/Position management/risk management).
- Usage of SQL, experience in Python, ANT scripting, JSON format.
- Ability to multitask several ongoing issues & assess priority.
- Effective interpersonal skills and relationship-building skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.
- Self-motivated and directed, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
 The expected base salary ranges from $70k-$100k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. 
 #LI-Hybrid 
 Other requirements 
 Mizuho has in place a hybrid working program, with varying opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role, needs of your department, as well as local laws and regulatory obligations. Roles in some of our departments have greater in-office requirements that will be communicated to you as part of the recruitment process .     
 Company Overview 
 Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is the 15th largest bank in the world as measured by total assets of ~$2 trillion. Mizuho's 60,000 employees worldwide offer comprehensive financial services to clients in 35 countries and 800 offices throughout the Americas, EMEA and Asia. Mizuho Americas is a leading provider of corporate and investment banking services

What if you could help shape how one of the world's leading healthcare companies prioritizes transformational investments and realizes measurable business impact? As the ED, Portfolio Prioritization & Value Realization Lead, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring Novartis' most strategic transformation initiatives receive the focus, resources, and governance needed to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working across senior leaders, Finance, Strategy, Technology, and business functions, you will drive portfolio decisions, create transparency around value realization, and help translate bold ambitions into sustainable results. This is a unique opportunity to influence enterprise-wide priorities, accelerate innovation, and help build the future of how Novartis operates. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
- Lead the integrated transformation portfolio across priorities, capacity, value, dependencies, risk, and readiness.
- Drive portfolio prioritization decisions to maximize business impact and strategic value realization.
- Recommend sequencing and investment trade-offs to optimize transformation outcomes and resource allocation.
- Establish and govern enterprise-wide value realization frameworks, metrics, and benefit tracking processes.
- Partner with Finance to validate business cases, benefit assumptions, baselines, and performance measures.
- Deliver actionable portfolio insights and scenario analyses to support executive decision-making.
- Identify risks, value leakage, capacity constraints, and execution challenges; drive corrective actions.
- Oversee artificial intelligence use case intake, triage, governance, and cross-functional review processes.
- Foster alignment across Strategy, Finance, Technology, and business leaders on transformation priorities.
- Build and lead a high-performing team that promotes rigor, transparency, and results-driven execution.
 Essential Requirements: 
- Education: Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, analytics, life sciences, healthcare, engineering, technology, or related discipline required. MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
- 12+ years of experience in portfolio management, enterprise PMO, transformation office, strategy execution, finance, consulting, business operations, or value-realization leadership. 
- Experience in pharma, biotech, healthcare, technology, or consulting organizations with high-volume intake, AI/digital case review, transformation funding, and benefits realization. 
- Proven ability to build portfolio governance, intake, prioritization logic, decision forums, value taxonomies, scorecards, and executive reporting for a complex transformation portfolio. 
- Experience challenging business cases, baselines, assumptions, benefit ownership, double-counting risk, capacity constraints, and readiness gaps. 
- Strong financial and analytical experience, including scenario analysis across value, capacity, timing, risk, dependencies, and investment trade-offs. 
- Ability to create fact-based transparency and force enterprise-level decisions when demand exceeds capacity or evidence does not support investment. 
- Portfolio prioritization; value-realization design; business-case challenge; financial acumen; KPI and benefits tracking; governance design; executive reporting; scenario modeling; stakeholder influence; risk and dependency management. 
 Desirable Requirements: 
- Experience partnering with Finance, Strategy, Commercial, Technology, P&O, Legal, ERC, and business leaders on prioritization and portfolio governance. 
- Experience with transformation analytics, Power BI/Tableau, portfolio management tools, AI-use-case triage, and product/Agile portfolio models.
